## Overview

This is the validation analysis of the PCCAT tumour-state scores derived in `comp_33_pccat_states`. It asks whether the atlas-derived 20-gene signatures measure what they claim in PRINCE GeoMx data, and whether there is direct evidence for neuroendocrine (NE) or AR-low/PSMA-low tumour regions.

Stage 1 works in the PCCAT atlas alone. Each signature is re-derived with a 5-fold leave-donor-out scheme and its held-out AUC is computed, and the expression of every signature gene in non-epithelial PCCAT lineages is tabulated. Stage 2 works in PRINCE. Genes are flagged as unsafe if they are expressed in non-epithelial atlas cells, if they are higher in CD45⁺ than tumour AOIs, or if they track deconvolved myeloid or erythroid fractions in tumour AOIs. This yields purity-safe signatures, and both the original and purity-safe sets are re-scored. Each signature is then checked for detection above LOQ, for gene–gene coherence against expression-matched random sets, for correlation with deconvolution and AOI quality, and for technical noise in the control-tissue AOIs. Stage 3 searches directly for AOIs with low *FOLH1* and low AR activity and for AOIs expressing canonical NE genes above LOQ.

The signatures were defined only from the external atlas, so no PRINCE outcome data enter their definition. Control-tissue AOIs are technical replicates and are used here only to estimate measurement noise.

**Manuscript items supported**

- Supplementary Table 67 (leave-donor-out specificity of PCCAT state signatures; `B1_leave_donor_out_AUC.csv`)
- Supplementary Table 68 (detection above LOQ, coherence and contamination; `B2_measurement_quality_by_stratum.csv`)
- Supplementary Table 71 (AOIs with *CHGA*, *CHGB* and *SYP* above LOQ; `B3_NE_positive_AOIs.csv`)
- Results: re-evaluation of neuroendocrine findings (held-out AUC of the chromogranin-high NE state; NE genes largely below background; double-negative-like, basal, club and hillock scores reflecting tumour content and myeloid–stromal genes)
- Methods: Atlas-derived tumour-state signatures

**Pipeline step:** `./run_pipeline.sh --only 33b_state_validation` (argument `all`: stage 1 validates the signatures in the PCCAT atlas and needs about 25 GB of free RAM; stage 2 applies them to PRINCE). Approximate runtime: Stage 2/3 about 1 min; stage 1 needs at least 25 GB free RAM to load the atlas.

**Inputs**

- `data/refs/pccat_subsample.qs`
- `data/phase2_se_qc_filtered.qs`
- `data/reference/msigdb_gene_sets.rds`
- `results/R11_pccat_states/A_PCCAT_state_signatures_top20.csv`
- `results/R1_loq/loq_gene_universes.qs`
- `results/C3_deconvolution/deconvolution_proportions.qs`

**Outputs**

- `results/R11_pccat_states/state_validation/B1_pccat_validation.qs`
- `results/R11_pccat_states/state_validation/B1_leave_donor_out_AUC.csv`
- `results/R11_pccat_states/state_validation/B1_signature_genes_nonepithelial_expression.csv`
- `results/R11_pccat_states/state_validation/B2_signature_gene_purity_flags.csv`
- `results/R11_pccat_states/state_validation/B2_purity_safe_signatures.csv`
- `results/R11_pccat_states/state_validation/B2_PRINCE_aoi_scores_original_and_safe.csv`
- `results/R11_pccat_states/state_validation/B2_measurement_quality_by_stratum.csv`
- `results/R11_pccat_states/state_validation/B2_control_tissue_reliability.csv`
- `results/R11_pccat_states/state_validation/B3_*.csv`

**Depends on**: `comp_03a_build_refs`, `comp_00b_bone_cohort`, `comp_16_loq_filter`, `comp_03b_deconv`, `comp_33_pccat_states`

## Analysis

Header. The script runs in up to three stages, chosen on the command line (`1`, `2` or `all`). Stage 1 uses the PCCAT atlas. Stages 2 and 3 use the PRINCE AOIs and run together under argument `2`.

Set-up: load the shared configuration and libraries, create the output folder (which must lie outside the input data folder) and read the 20-gene signatures written by `comp_33_pccat_states`. `auc_fun` computes the area under the ROC curve from ranks (Mann–Whitney form) and is used throughout.

```{r comp-33b-state-validation-01}
## ============================================================================
## PRINCE R11 -- state-signature validation: are the PCCAT tumour-state signatures trustworthy
## measurements in PRINCE GeoMx, and is there direct evidence for NEPC-like / AR-low-PSMA-low regions?
##  Stage 1 (PCCAT reference): leave-donor-out (5-fold by donor) re-derivation + held-out AUC;
##          expression of signature genes in non-epithelial PCCAT lineages (ct.L1 / ct.L2).
##  Stage 2 (PRINCE): purity-safe signatures (reference + in-situ rules), re-scoring, LOQ detection,
##          coherence vs expression-matched random sets, correlation with deconvolution / AOI quality,
##          technical-noise check on control-tissue AOIs.
##  Stage 3 (PRINCE): direct search for AR-low/PSMA-low and NE-positive AOIs.
## Usage: Rscript comp_33b_state_validation.R [1|2|all]
## ============================================================================
source(file.path(Sys.getenv("PRINCE_ROOT", "."), ".build", "comp_00_guard.R"))
suppressMessages({ library(qs); library(Matrix); library(SummarizedExperiment); library(dplyr); library(tidyr)
  library(edgeR); library(singscore) })
setwd(PRINCE_DIR)
OUT <- file.path(COMP_DIR, "R11_pccat_states", "state_validation"); dir.create(OUT, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
stopifnot(!startsWith(normalizePath(OUT), normalizePath(PRINCE_DIR)))
args <- commandArgs(TRUE); stage <- if (length(args)) args[1] else "all"
R11 <- file.path(COMP_DIR, "R11_pccat_states")
sig_tab <- read.csv(file.path(R11, "A_PCCAT_state_signatures_top20.csv"), check.names = FALSE)
sig_list <- split(sig_tab$gene, sig_tab$signature)
auc_fun <- function(score, lab) { ok <- !is.na(score); score <- score[ok]; lab <- lab[ok]
  n1 <- sum(lab); n0 <- sum(!lab); if (n1 == 0 || n0 == 0) return(NA)
  (sum(rank(score)[lab]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n0) }

```

### Stage 1: leave-donor-out validation in the PCCAT atlas
- Load the atlas subsample and scale counts to 10,000 per cell. Compute the mean expression and detection rate of the signature genes, plus *AR*, *FOLH1*, *CHGA*, *SYP* and *KRT7*, in every coarse (ct.L1) and fine (ct.L2) lineage.
- Restrict to epithelial cells from CRPC, mCRPC and NEPC samples, as in `comp_33`. Double-negative-like (DNPC-like) cells are non-NE cells with zero counts for *AR*, *FOLH1*, *CHGA*, *SYP*, *INSM1* and *ASCL1*. Because zero counts are commoner in small libraries, the AUC of low library size for this label is recorded as a confound check.
- `stats_for` repeats the derivation rule: genes detected in ≥25% of the state's cells with mean ≥1 CPM10k, ranked by log₂ fold change, kept if higher in ≥70% of donors with ≥10 cells of the state, top 20. Re-deriving on all data first confirms that the published signatures are reproduced.
- Donors are split into 5 folds (seed 11). Each signature is re-derived on four folds and scored on the held-out donors (mean log1p expression). AUCs are reported against all other epithelial cells and against the training contrast, with the median AUC per held-out donor and the AUC of library size alone as a baseline.
- For each signature gene, record its expression in the state and the highest mean in any non-epithelial lineage, as a ratio used by the purity rules in stage 2.

```{r comp-33b-state-validation-02}
## =============================== STAGE 1: PCCAT ==================================================
if (stage %in% c("1", "all")) {
  check_ram_or_stop(25)
  pc <- qs::qread("refs/pccat_subsample.qs", nthreads = 1); Xall <- pc$counts; mall <- pc$meta; rm(pc); invisible(gc())
  cat("PCCAT:", dim(Xall), "\n"); print(table(mall$ct.L1)); print(table(mall$ct.L2, mall$ct.L1)[, , drop = FALSE]); print(table(mall$Group2))
  liball <- pmax(Matrix::colSums(Xall), 1)
  sg_genes <- intersect(unique(c(sig_tab$gene, "AR", "FOLH1", "CHGA", "SYP", "KRT7")), rownames(Xall))
  Ns <- Xall[sg_genes, ] %*% Diagonal(x = 1e4 / liball); colnames(Ns) <- colnames(Xall)
  ## (b) lineage means (CPM10k) and detection by ct.L1 and ct.L2, all cells
  grp_means <- function(f) { f <- as.character(f); f[is.na(f)] <- "NA"; lv <- sort(unique(f))
    M <- sapply(lv, function(l) Matrix::rowMeans(Ns[, f == l, drop = FALSE]))
    D <- sapply(lv, function(l) Matrix::rowMeans(Ns[, f == l, drop = FALSE] > 0))
    list(mean = M, det = D, n = table(f)) }
  L1 <- grp_means(mall$ct.L1); L2 <- grp_means(mall$ct.L2)
  ## epithelial cells for derivation (identical to comp_33)
  epi_l2 <- c("Luminal", "Basal", "Club", "Hillock", "LPCs", "NE")
  epi <- mall$ct.L2 %in% epi_l2 & mall$Group2 %in% c("CRPC", "mCRPC", "NEPC") & !is.na(mall$ct.L3)
  epi_L1 <- names(sort(table(mall$ct.L1[mall$ct.L2 %in% epi_l2]), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
  cat("epithelial ct.L1 label:", epi_L1, "\n")
  X <- Xall[, epi]; m <- mall[epi, ]; lib <- liball[epi]; rm(Xall); invisible(gc())
  Xn <- X %*% Diagonal(x = 1e4 / lib); colnames(Xn) <- colnames(X); rm(X); invisible(gc())
  m$coarse <- ifelse(m$ct.L2 == "NE", "NE_all", paste0(m$ct.L2, "_all"))
  g0 <- function(g) if (g %in% rownames(Xn)) Xn[g, ] == 0 else rep(TRUE, ncol(Xn))
  dn_cells <- m$ct.L2 != "NE" & g0("AR") & g0("FOLH1") & g0("CHGA") & g0("SYP") & g0("INSM1") & g0("ASCL1")
  arpos <- m$ct.L2 == "Luminal" & Xn["AR", ] > 0 & Xn["FOLH1", ] > 0
  ## library-size confound of the DNPC-like definition
  dn_lib <- data.frame(group = c("DNPC_like", "ARpos_FOLH1pos_luminal", "other_epithelial"),
    n = c(sum(dn_cells), sum(arpos), sum(!dn_cells & !arpos)),
    median_UMI = c(median(lib[dn_cells]), median(lib[arpos]), median(lib[!dn_cells & !arpos])))
  dn_lib$AUC_libsize_low_predicts_DNPC <- c(auc_fun(-lib, dn_cells), NA, NA)
  dn_ct <- as.data.frame(table(ct.L3 = m$ct.L3[dn_cells])); dn_grp <- as.data.frame(table(Group2 = m$Group2[dn_cells]))
  cat("DNPC-like composition:\n"); print(dn_lib); print(dn_ct)

  stats_for <- function(in_cells, out_cells, label) {
    mi <- Matrix::rowMeans(Xn[, in_cells, drop = FALSE]); mo <- Matrix::rowMeans(Xn[, out_cells, drop = FALSE])
    det <- Matrix::rowMeans(Xn[, in_cells, drop = FALSE] > 0); lfc <- log2(mi + 0.1) - log2(mo + 0.1)
    dn <- table(m$Donor_ID[in_cells]); dn <- names(dn[dn >= 10])
    cand <- names(sort(lfc[det >= 0.25 & mi >= 1], decreasing = TRUE))[1:200]; cand <- cand[!is.na(cand)]
    if (!length(cand)) return(character(0))
    cons <- if (length(dn) >= 2) rowMeans(sapply(dn, function(d) Matrix::rowMeans(Xn[cand, in_cells & m$Donor_ID == d, drop = FALSE]) > mo[cand])) else setNames(rep(1, length(cand)), cand)
    head(cand[cons >= 0.7], 20) }
  ## sanity: full-data re-derivation reproduces the published signatures
  defs <- c(setNames(lapply(sort(unique(m$ct.L3)), function(s) list(inn = m$ct.L3 == s, out = m$ct.L3 != s)), sort(unique(m$ct.L3))),
            setNames(lapply(sort(unique(m$coarse)), function(s) list(inn = m$coarse == s, out = m$coarse != s)), sort(unique(m$coarse))),
            list(DNPC_like = list(inn = dn_cells, out = arpos), ARpos_PSMApos_luminal = list(inn = arpos, out = dn_cells)))
  repro <- sapply(names(defs), function(s) length(intersect(stats_for(defs[[s]]$inn, defs[[s]]$out, s), sig_list[[s]])))
  cat("full-data reproduction (overlap /20):\n"); print(repro)
  ## (a) leave-donor-out, 5 folds by donor
  set.seed(11); donors <- unique(m$Donor_ID); fold <- setNames(sample(rep(1:5, length.out = length(donors))), donors)
  cf <- fold[m$Donor_ID]
  score_cells <- function(genes, cells) { genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(Xn)); if (length(genes) < 3) return(rep(NA, sum(cells)))
    Matrix::colMeans(log1p(Xn[genes, cells, drop = FALSE])) }
  held <- matrix(NA_real_, ncol(Xn), length(defs), dimnames = list(colnames(Xn), names(defs)))
  full <- held; ldo_overlap <- matrix(NA, 5, length(defs), dimnames = list(NULL, names(defs)))
  for (s in names(defs)) full[, s] <- score_cells(sig_list[[s]], rep(TRUE, ncol(Xn)))
  for (k in 1:5) { tr <- cf != k; te <- cf == k; cat("fold", k, "held-out cells", sum(te), "\n")
    for (s in names(defs)) { g <- stats_for(defs[[s]]$inn & tr, defs[[s]]$out & tr, s)
      ldo_overlap[k, s] <- length(intersect(g, sig_list[[s]])); held[te, s] <- score_cells(g, te) } }
  ldo <- bind_rows(lapply(names(defs), function(s) { inn <- defs[[s]]$inn; out <- defs[[s]]$out
    others <- !inn  # all other epithelial cells
    data.frame(signature = s, n_cells = sum(inn), n_donors_with_state = length(unique(m$Donor_ID[inn])),
      n_donors_ge10 = sum(table(m$Donor_ID[inn]) >= 10),
      AUC_heldout_vs_other_epi = auc_fun(held[, s], inn), AUC_heldout_vs_training_contrast = auc_fun(held[inn | out, s], inn[inn | out]),
      AUC_fullsig_in_sample = auc_fun(full[, s], inn), mean_gene_overlap_fold_vs_full = mean(ldo_overlap[, s]),
      AUC_low_libsize_alone = auc_fun(-lib, inn)) }))
  ## per-donor held-out AUC (donors with >= 10 cells of the state), robustness
  ldo$median_AUC_per_heldout_donor <- sapply(ldo$signature, function(s) { inn <- defs[[s]]$inn
    dd <- names(which(table(m$Donor_ID[inn]) >= 10)); if (!length(dd)) return(NA)
    median(sapply(dd, function(d) { c0 <- m$Donor_ID == d; auc_fun(held[c0, s], inn[c0]) }), na.rm = TRUE) })
  print(ldo)
  ## epithelial-state means of each gene (for purity rule) and non-epithelial lineage table
  non_epi_L1 <- setdiff(colnames(L1$mean), c(epi_L1, "NA"))
  gene_tab <- bind_rows(lapply(names(sig_list), function(s) { g <- intersect(sig_list[[s]], rownames(Ns)); inn <- defs[[s]]$inn
    mi <- Matrix::rowMeans(Xn[g, inn, drop = FALSE])
    nm <- L1$mean[g, non_epi_L1, drop = FALSE]; nd <- L1$det[g, non_epi_L1, drop = FALSE]
    l2_non <- setdiff(colnames(L2$mean), c(epi_l2, "NA")); n2 <- L2$mean[g, l2_non, drop = FALSE]
    data.frame(signature = s, gene = g, state_mean_CPM10k = mi, epi_all_mean = L1$mean[g, epi_L1],
      max_nonepi_L1 = colnames(nm)[max.col(nm, ties.method = "first")], max_nonepi_L1_mean = apply(nm, 1, max),
      max_nonepi_L1_det = apply(nd, 1, max),
      max_nonepi_L2 = colnames(n2)[max.col(n2, ties.method = "first")], max_nonepi_L2_mean = apply(n2, 1, max),
      nm, check.names = FALSE) }))
  gene_tab$ratio_state_vs_max_nonepi <- gene_tab$state_mean_CPM10k / pmax(pmax(gene_tab$max_nonepi_L1_mean, gene_tab$max_nonepi_L2_mean), 1e-3)
  qs::qsave(list(ldo = ldo, ldo_overlap = ldo_overlap, gene_tab = gene_tab, L1 = L1, L2 = L2, dn_lib = dn_lib, dn_ct = dn_ct,
                 dn_grp = dn_grp, repro = repro, epi_L1 = epi_L1), file.path(OUT, "B1_pccat_validation.qs"))
  write.csv(ldo, file.path(OUT, "B1_leave_donor_out_AUC.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(gene_tab, file.path(OUT, "B1_signature_genes_nonepithelial_expression.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  rm(Xn, Ns); invisible(gc()); cat("Stage 1 done\n")
}

```

### Stages 2 and 3: measurement quality in PRINCE and direct search
- **In-situ purity rules.** On TMM log-CPM of patient AOIs, compute the median tumour-minus-CD45⁺ difference per gene in primary and bone tissue, and the Spearman correlation with deconvolved myeloid and erythroid fractions across tumour AOIs. A gene is purity-safe if it is on the panel, its state/non-epithelial ratio in the atlas is ≥4, it is not >0.25 log₂ higher in CD45⁺ AOIs, and it has no ρ > 0.3 with marrow fractions.
- **Re-scoring.** Original and purity-safe sets, plus Hallmark androgen response, are scored with singscore on each stratum's LOQ gene universe (≥5 genes). Control AOIs are scored in the Archival universe of their segment. A lenient mean-z score over all panel genes of each safe set is added for interpretation only.
- **Coherence and confounding.** Mean pairwise correlation of batch-centred log-CPM is compared with 500 random gene sets matched on expression (20 bins), giving a z score and empirical P. Spearman correlations with tumour, myeloid, marrow, T/NK and erythroid fractions and with % genes above LOQ need ≥10 AOIs. Reliability is 1 − (control variance / patient Archival variance).
- **Stage 3.** NE genes are called above the per-AOI LOQ. Within each tumour stratum, double-low AOIs have *FOLH1* and Hallmark AR scores both in the lowest 10% or 25%. The stage writes NE-positive AOIs (≥2 core NE genes, or *CHGA*, *CHGB* and *SYP* all above LOQ), NE detection rates by stratum and in control tissue, per-patient counts of double-low AOIs, and Wilcoxon comparisons of double-low against other tumour AOIs.

```{r comp-33b-state-validation-03}
## =============================== STAGE 2 + 3: PRINCE =============================================
if (stage %in% c("2", "all")) {
  B1 <- qs::qread(file.path(OUT, "B1_pccat_validation.qs")); gene_tab <- B1$gene_tab
  se <- qs::qread("phase2_se_qc_filtered.qs"); cd <- as.data.frame(colData(se))
  U <- qs::qread(file.path(COMP_DIR, "R1_loq", "loq_gene_universes.qs")); uni <- U$universes; loq_aoi <- U$aoi
  dec <- qs::qread(file.path(COMP_DIR, "C3_deconvolution", "deconvolution_proportions.qs"))
  msig <- readRDS(file.path(PMCC_DIR, "msigdb_gene_sets.rds"))
  artefact_re <- "^(USP17L|PRAMEF|NBPF|OR[0-9]+[A-Z]+[0-9]+)"
  counts_all <- assay(se, "all_count"); counts_all <- counts_all[!grepl(artefact_re, rownames(counts_all)), ]
  code <- c("CD45+" = "CD45", "PSMA+" = "PSMA", "PanCK+PSMA-" = "PanCKPSMA"); tps <- c("Archival", "Screening", "Cycle1")
  is_ctrl <- cd$response_group_neat == "Control"
  ## per-AOI LOQ calls on raw counts
  loq <- loq_aoi[colnames(se), "LOQ_std"]; above <- sweep(as.matrix(counts_all), 2, loq, ">")

  ## ---- in-situ rules (PRINCE): CD45+ vs tumour AOIs; correlation with myeloid/erythroid in bone tumour AOIs
  lc_all <- cpm(calcNormFactors(DGEList(counts_all[, !is_ctrl])), log = TRUE, prior.count = 1); cdn <- cd[!is_ctrl, ]
  tum <- cdn$segment_name %in% c("PSMA+", "PanCK+PSMA-"); imm <- cdn$segment_name == "CD45+"
  prim <- cdn$timepoint == "Archival"; bone <- cdn$timepoint %in% c("Screening", "Cycle1")
  sgg <- intersect(unique(gene_tab$gene), rownames(lc_all))
  lfc_tum_cd45 <- function(sel) apply(lc_all[sgg, , drop = FALSE], 1, function(x) median(x[tum & sel]) - median(x[imm & sel]))
  insitu <- data.frame(gene = sgg, tum_minus_CD45_primary = lfc_tum_cd45(prim), tum_minus_CD45_bone = lfc_tum_cd45(bone))
  bt <- which(tum & bone); bta <- colnames(lc_all)[bt]; lb <- dec$lineage_bone
  okb <- bta %in% rownames(lb)
  insitu$rho_bone_tumour_Myeloid <- apply(lc_all[sgg, bt[okb]], 1, function(x) cor(x, lb[bta[okb], "Myeloid"], method = "spearman"))
  insitu$rho_bone_tumour_Erythroid <- apply(lc_all[sgg, bt[okb]], 1, function(x) cor(x, lb[bta[okb], "Erythroid_progenitor"], method = "spearman"))
  pt <- which(tum & prim); pta <- colnames(lc_all)[pt]; lp <- dec$lineage_primary; okp <- pta %in% rownames(lp)
  insitu$rho_primary_tumour_Myeloid <- apply(lc_all[sgg, pt[okp]], 1, function(x) cor(x, lp[pta[okp], "Myeloid"], method = "spearman"))
  gene_tab <- left_join(gene_tab, insitu, by = "gene")
  ## purity rules
  gene_tab <- gene_tab %>% mutate(
    flag_ref_nonepi = ratio_state_vs_max_nonepi < 4,
    on_panel = gene %in% rownames(counts_all),
    flag_insitu_CD45 = !is.na(tum_minus_CD45_primary) & (tum_minus_CD45_primary < -0.25 | tum_minus_CD45_bone < -0.25),  # CD45+ AOIs higher by > 0.25 log2
    flag_insitu_marrow = !is.na(rho_bone_tumour_Myeloid) & (rho_bone_tumour_Myeloid > 0.3 | rho_bone_tumour_Erythroid > 0.3 | rho_primary_tumour_Myeloid > 0.3),
    purity_safe = on_panel & !flag_ref_nonepi & !flag_insitu_CD45 & !flag_insitu_marrow)
  write.csv(gene_tab, file.path(OUT, "B2_signature_gene_purity_flags.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  key <- c("NE_all", "NE_FOXA2", "NE_EZH2", "NE_CHG+", "DNPC_like", "Hillock", "Hillock_all", "Club_all", "Basal_all", "LPCs_all")
  safe_list <- lapply(setNames(names(sig_list), paste0(names(sig_list), "_safe")), function(s) gene_tab$gene[gene_tab$signature == s & gene_tab$purity_safe])
  safe_def <- bind_rows(lapply(names(safe_list), function(s) if (length(safe_list[[s]])) data.frame(signature = s, gene = safe_list[[s]]) ))
  write.csv(safe_def, file.path(OUT, "B2_purity_safe_signatures.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  ## ---- re-score (comp_33 method) original + safe, incl. control AOIs (scored in the Archival universe of the segment)
  all_sets <- c(sig_list, safe_list, list(AR_Hallmark = msig$H$HALLMARK_ANDROGEN_RESPONSE))
  sc <- list(); qual <- list(); lcs <- list()
  for (sg in names(code)) for (tp in c(tps, "Control")) {
    sid <- paste0(code[sg], "__", tp); usid <- if (tp == "Control") paste0(code[sg], "__Archival") else sid
    g <- intersect(uni[[usid]]$g10, rownames(counts_all))
    idx <- which(cd$segment_name == sg & (if (tp == "Control") is_ctrl else (!is_ctrl & cd$timepoint == tp)))
    lc <- cpm(calcNormFactors(DGEList(counts_all[g, idx])), log = TRUE, prior.count = 1); rk <- rankGenes(lc); lcs[[sid]] <- lc
    S <- sapply(all_sets, function(gs) { gg <- intersect(gs, rownames(lc)); if (length(gg) >= 5) simpleScore(rk, upSet = gg)$TotalScore else rep(NA, ncol(lc)) })
    sc[[sid]] <- data.frame(aoi = colnames(lc), stratum = sid, segment = sg, timepoint = cd$timepoint[idx], subject_id = cd$subject_id[idx],
      response = cd$response_group_neat[idx], batch = cd$study_batch[idx], pct_above_LOQ_std = loq_aoi[colnames(lc), "pct_above_LOQ_std"],
      FOLH1 = lc["FOLH1", ], AR = if ("AR" %in% rownames(lc)) lc["AR", ] else NA, S, check.names = FALSE)
    ## lenient supplementary score for purity-safe sets: mean within-stratum z of logCPM over ALL panel genes of the safe set
    ## (>= 2 genes, LOQ not required; n genes above LOQ reported) -- for interpretation only, below-LOQ genes add noise
    lf <- cpm(calcNormFactors(DGEList(counts_all[, idx])), log = TRUE, prior.count = 1); zf <- t(scale(t(lf)))
    for (s in names(safe_list)) { gg <- intersect(safe_list[[s]], rownames(zf))
      sc[[sid]][[paste0(s, "_meanz")]] <- if (length(gg) >= 2) colMeans(zf[gg, , drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE) else NA
      sc[[sid]][[paste0(s, "_nLOQ")]] <- length(intersect(gg, g)) }
    qual[[sid]] <- data.frame(stratum = sid, signature = names(all_sets), n_genes = lengths(all_sets),
      n_above_LOQ = sapply(all_sets, function(gs) length(intersect(gs, g)))) }
  scores <- bind_rows(sc); write.csv(scores, file.path(OUT, "B2_PRINCE_aoi_scores_original_and_safe.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  ## ---- coherence vs expression-matched random sets (batch-centred logCPM, patient AOIs only)
  set.seed(7); coh <- list()
  for (sid in grep("Control", names(lcs), invert = TRUE, value = TRUE)) {
    lc <- lcs[[sid]]; b <- scores$batch[scores$stratum == sid]
    lcc <- lc; for (bb in unique(b)) lcc[, b == bb] <- lcc[, b == bb] - rowMeans(lcc[, b == bb, drop = FALSE])
    mu <- rowMeans(lc); bins <- cut(rank(mu), 20, labels = FALSE); names(bins) <- rownames(lc)
    mpc <- function(gg) { C <- cor(t(lcc[gg, , drop = FALSE])); mean(C[upper.tri(C)], na.rm = TRUE) }
    for (s in c(names(sig_list), names(safe_list))) { gg <- intersect(all_sets[[s]], rownames(lc)); if (length(gg) < 3) next
      obs <- mpc(gg); nul <- replicate(500, mpc(unlist(lapply(bins[gg], function(bi) sample(names(bins)[bins == bi], 1)))))
      coh[[paste(sid, s)]] <- data.frame(stratum = sid, signature = s, n_genes_scored = length(gg), mean_pairwise_r = obs,
        null_mean = mean(nul), null_sd = sd(nul), z = (obs - mean(nul)) / sd(nul), p_emp = (sum(nul >= obs) + 1) / 501) } }
  coh <- bind_rows(coh)

  ## ---- association with deconvolution and AOI quality
  lin <- rbind(cbind(as.data.frame(dec$lineage_primary)[, c("Epithelial_tumour", "Myeloid", "T_NK")], Erythroid_progenitor = NA, Bone_cells = NA),
               as.data.frame(dec$lineage_bone)[, c("Epithelial_tumour", "Myeloid", "T_NK", "Erythroid_progenitor", "Bone_cells")])
  lin$aoi <- c(rownames(dec$lineage_primary), rownames(dec$lineage_bone)); lin$Marrow <- lin$Myeloid + ifelse(is.na(lin$Erythroid_progenitor), 0, lin$Erythroid_progenitor)
  sd2 <- left_join(scores %>% filter(timepoint != "ControlTissue", response != "Control"), lin, by = "aoi")
  cov <- c("Epithelial_tumour", "Myeloid", "Marrow", "T_NK", "Erythroid_progenitor", "pct_above_LOQ_std")
  assoc <- bind_rows(lapply(unique(sd2$stratum), function(sid) { d <- sd2[sd2$stratum == sid, ]
    bind_rows(lapply(c(names(sig_list), names(safe_list), "AR_Hallmark"), function(s) { x <- d[[s]]; if (all(is.na(x))) return(NULL)
      data.frame(stratum = sid, signature = s, t(sapply(cov, function(v) if (sum(!is.na(d[[v]]) & !is.na(x)) >= 10 && sd(d[[v]], na.rm = TRUE) > 0) cor(x, d[[v]], method = "spearman", use = "complete") else NA))) })) }))
  names(assoc)[-(1:2)] <- paste0("rho_", cov)

  ## ---- technical noise: control-tissue AOIs (technical replicates) vs patient Archival AOIs
  noise <- bind_rows(lapply(names(code), function(sg) { c0 <- scores[scores$stratum == paste0(code[sg], "__Control"), ]
    p0 <- scores[scores$stratum == paste0(code[sg], "__Archival"), ]
    bind_rows(lapply(c(names(sig_list), names(safe_list), "AR_Hallmark"), function(s) if (all(is.na(p0[[s]]))) NULL else
      data.frame(segment = sg, signature = s, sd_control = sd(c0[[s]], na.rm = TRUE), sd_patient_archival = sd(p0[[s]], na.rm = TRUE),
        reliability = 1 - var(c0[[s]], na.rm = TRUE) / var(p0[[s]], na.rm = TRUE)))) }))

  qtab <- bind_rows(qual) %>% mutate(frac_above_LOQ = n_above_LOQ / n_genes) %>%
    left_join(coh %>% dplyr::select(stratum, signature, mean_pairwise_r, z, p_emp), by = c("stratum", "signature")) %>%
    left_join(assoc, by = c("stratum", "signature"))
  write.csv(qtab, file.path(OUT, "B2_measurement_quality_by_stratum.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(noise, file.path(OUT, "B2_control_tissue_reliability.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

  ## =============================== STAGE 3: direct search ==========================================
  ne_g <- intersect(c("CHGA", "CHGB", "SYP", "SCG3", "SCG2", "INSM1", "ASCL1", "ENO2", "NCAM1", "KRT7"), rownames(above))
  ne_call <- as.data.frame(t(above[ne_g, ])); colnames(ne_call) <- paste0(ne_g, "_aboveLOQ"); ne_call$aoi <- rownames(ne_call)
  ne_call$n_core_NE_aboveLOQ <- rowSums(ne_call[, paste0(intersect(c("CHGA", "CHGB", "SYP", "INSM1", "ASCL1", "SCG2"), ne_g), "_aboveLOQ")])
  ne_cnt <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(counts_all[intersect(c("CHGA", "CHGB", "SYP"), rownames(counts_all)), ]))); colnames(ne_cnt) <- paste0(colnames(ne_cnt), "_count"); ne_cnt$aoi <- rownames(ne_cnt)
  nefr <- data.frame(aoi = c(rownames(dec$prop_bone), rownames(dec$prop_primary)),
    NE_fraction = c(dec$prop_bone[, "Tumour_NE"], dec$prop_primary[, "NE"]))
  full3 <- scores %>% left_join(ne_call, by = "aoi") %>% left_join(ne_cnt, by = "aoi") %>% left_join(nefr, by = "aoi") %>% left_join(lin, by = "aoi")
  tumour <- full3 %>% filter(segment %in% c("PSMA+", "PanCK+PSMA-"), response != "Control") %>% group_by(stratum) %>%
    mutate(FOLH1_pct = percent_rank(FOLH1), ARH_pct = percent_rank(AR_Hallmark), AR_pct = percent_rank(AR),
           double_low_d10 = FOLH1_pct <= 0.10 & ARH_pct <= 0.10, double_low_q25 = FOLH1_pct <= 0.25 & ARH_pct <= 0.25) %>% ungroup()
  safe_cols <- intersect(paste0(key, "_safe"), names(tumour))
  ## percentile of each safe score within stratum (for profiling)
  for (s in c(safe_cols, key)) if (s %in% names(tumour)) tumour <- tumour %>% group_by(stratum) %>% mutate(!!paste0(s, "_pct") := percent_rank(.data[[s]])) %>% ungroup()
  dl <- tumour %>% filter(double_low_q25)
  write.csv(tumour, file.path(OUT, "B3_tumour_aoi_profile.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(dl, file.path(OUT, "B3_double_low_AOIs_q25.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  ## NE evidence across all patient AOIs + controls
  ne_all <- full3 %>% mutate(CHGA_CHGB_SYP_all = CHGA_aboveLOQ & CHGB_aboveLOQ & SYP_aboveLOQ)
  write.csv(ne_all %>% filter(n_core_NE_aboveLOQ >= 2 | CHGA_CHGB_SYP_all) %>% arrange(desc(n_core_NE_aboveLOQ)),
            file.path(OUT, "B3_NE_positive_AOIs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  ne_rate <- ne_all %>% mutate(grp = ifelse(response == "Control", "Control", stratum)) %>% group_by(grp) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), across(all_of(paste0(ne_g, "_aboveLOQ")), mean), CHGA_CHGB_SYP_all = sum(CHGA_CHGB_SYP_all), ge2_core = sum(n_core_NE_aboveLOQ >= 2))
  write.csv(ne_rate, file.path(OUT, "B3_NE_gene_detection_rates.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  ## patient-level enrichment of double-low AOIs and response
  pat_dl <- tumour %>% group_by(subject_id, response) %>% summarise(n_tumour_aoi = n(), n_double_low_d10 = sum(double_low_d10), n_double_low_q25 = sum(double_low_q25),
    max_NE_core = max(n_core_NE_aboveLOQ), n_CHGA_aboveLOQ = sum(CHGA_aboveLOQ), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(desc(n_double_low_q25))
  write.csv(pat_dl, file.path(OUT, "B3_patient_double_low_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  ## double-low vs other tumour AOIs: profile contrasts
  prof_vars <- c(paste0(safe_cols), key, "Myeloid", "Marrow", "Epithelial_tumour", "pct_above_LOQ_std", "NE_fraction", "KRT7_aboveLOQ", "CHGA_aboveLOQ", "n_core_NE_aboveLOQ")
  prof <- bind_rows(lapply(intersect(prof_vars, names(tumour)), function(v) { x <- as.numeric(tumour[[v]])
    data.frame(variable = v, median_double_low_q25 = median(x[tumour$double_low_q25], na.rm = TRUE), median_other = median(x[!tumour$double_low_q25], na.rm = TRUE),
      wilcox_p = tryCatch(wilcox.test(x[tumour$double_low_q25], x[!tumour$double_low_q25])$p.value, error = function(e) NA)) }))
  write.csv(prof, file.path(OUT, "B3_double_low_vs_other_profile.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  qs::qsave(list(gene_tab = gene_tab, safe = safe_list, scores = scores, coh = coh, assoc = assoc, noise = noise, qtab = qtab,
                 tumour = tumour, ne_rate = ne_rate, pat_dl = pat_dl, prof = prof), file.path(OUT, "B2_B3_results.qs"))
  cat("Stage 2/3 done\n")
}
```
